Messages.Author: Legbiter
Messages.Body:
This come up during the tournament. Votes are just like any other action,
correct [new rule book p41, section 18.3 - cf p39, section 18.1]? IE
blockable by Prey or Predator but NO-ONE ELSE [short of an Anneke or
Eagles' Sight]?

It's just that the other group have got it into their heads that ANYONE
can block a political action. I had to accept it because I didn't have a
rule book handy and had to do a LOT of demeaning grovelling to get my
grand-predator/prey to vote with me.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Legbiter wrote:
>
> This come up during the tournament. Votes are just like any other action,
> correct [new rule book p41, section 18.3 - cf p39, section 18.1]? IE
> blockable by Prey or Predator but NO-ONE ELSE [short of an Anneke or
> Eagles' Sight]?

Correct (if you include Enzo Giovanni in your short list).

Political Actions are undirected actions, and as such can only
be blocked by minions of your Predator or Prey.
